The '''Gorm Academy''' was a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gorm]]. It was built by [[Unidentified architect|architect]] who hid several secrets in the establishment. The [[academy]] was overseen by caretakers who allowed an individual to study the building in exchange for a donation.<ref name="Gorm Academy">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Gorm Academy}}</ref>
